passages.text: Think of ChatGPT like a very good intern: it does exceptionally well… if it knows first the 4W to perform the tasks. And I’m not the only one obsessing over it:
Now that you know **WHY** you must master context engineering, let’s master the **HOW** together. Here’s my step-by-step guide on:
> Step 1. Gap check – list any information still missing; ask me concise questions until gaps are filled.
> • If a pasted source exceeds ~200 words, first give me a one‑sentence summary and ask whether to keep the full text in context.

### Example 1: From a long PDF to a one-pager.
> Step 1. Gap check – list any information still missing; ask me concise questions until gaps are filled.

> If a pasted source exceeds \~200 words, first give me a one-sentence summary and ask whether to keep the full text. If you need knowledge I have not supplied, list it in Gap check instead of searching externally.
